title: The Martian
overview: An astronaut stranded alone on Mars uses botany, engineering and dark humor to survive while NASA races to bring him home.

title: Interstellar
overview: With Earth's crops failing, a former pilot leads a crew through a wormhole to find a new home, while time slips away from the daughter he left behind.

title: Paddington 2
overview: A polite bear who loves marmalade is wrongly jailed and wins over his fellow prisoners while his London family hunts for the real thief.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
overview: In a desert wasteland, a rebel driver and a drifter flee a warlord in a nonstop armored-truck chase.

title: Spirited Away
overview: A girl wanders into a spirit world bathhouse and must work there to rescue her parents, who have been turned into pigs.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
overview: A legendary hotel concierge and his loyal lobby boy get tangled in a stolen-painting caper across a pastel-colored Europe.

title: Heat
overview: A disciplined crew of professional thieves in Los Angeles is pursued by an obsessive police detective.

title: Toy Story
overview: A cowboy doll feels replaced when a flashy space-ranger toy arrives, and the rivals must team up to get back to their kid.

title: Gravity
overview: After debris destroys their shuttle, an engineer drifts through orbit trying to reach a station and get back to Earth.

title: Get Out
overview: A young man's weekend visit to his girlfriend's family estate turns sinister as he uncovers what they really want.

title: Groundhog Day
overview: A cynical TV weatherman is forced to relive the same small-town day over and over until he changes how he lives.

title: The Matrix
overview: A hacker learns his everyday reality is a simulation run by machines and joins a rebellion to free humanity.

title: Moneyball
overview: A baseball general manager with a tiny budget uses statistics to build a competitive team against the odds.

title: Coco
overview: A boy who dreams of becoming a musician crosses into the Land of the Dead to uncover his family's history.

title: Ford v Ferrari
overview: A car designer and a hot-headed driver build a race car to beat Ferrari at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

title: Knives Out
overview: A quirky detective investigates the death of a wealthy crime novelist whose family members all have something to hide.
